name: Rice Purity Test
author: fazalniazi

sections.description:
Rice Purity Test is a lightweight, self-contained quiz plugin inspired by the famous college tradition that started at Rice University and has since become one of the most popular self-reflection checklists on the internet. Add the shortcode [niazinq_score_test] to any page or post and visitors can:

  • Check off 50 fun, everyday life experiences
  • See a live progress bar as they go
  • Get an instant Purity Score out of 100 with a fun title and description
  • Copy and share their result
  • Retake the test anytime to see how their score has changed

All 50 questions are completely family-friendly — no inappropriate content. Safe for all ages and all audiences.

The Rice Purity Test format has been a favorite among college students for decades, often taken at the start of freshman year and again before graduation as a way to look back on how much has changed. This plugin brings that same nostalgic, shareable experience directly to your own website, with no external services, no data collection, and no complicated setup.

Features

  • Simple shortcode: [niazinq_score_test]
  • Clean, modern, mobile-responsive design
  • No database tables, no settings page — works instantly after activation
  • Lightweight CSS/JS, loads only on pages where the shortcode is used
  • Fully self-contained (no external API calls, no tracking)
  • Instant score calculation with a friendly result summary
  • Visitors can retake the test anytime to track how their score changes over time

Why Use This Plugin

  • Taps into a well-known, widely searched quiz format that already has a built-in audience
  • Keeps visitors engaged longer with an interactive, checklist-style experience
  • Encourages organic social sharing since results are easy to copy and post
  • Zero maintenance — no database, no user accounts, no ongoing configuration
  • Works well for quiz sites, student life blogs, community sites, and entertainment pages
sections.installation:
1. Upload the niazi-innocence-quiz folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the zip directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Add the shortcode [niazinq_score_test] to any page or post where you want the quiz to appear.
sections.faq:
Is this the official Rice Purity Test?

No. This plugin offers an independently created, family-friendly quiz inspired by the well-known Rice Purity Test tradition. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rice University.

Can I change the questions?

Yes. Open niazi-innocence-quiz.php and edit the array inside the niq_get_questions() function.

Does this store any user data?

No. All scoring happens entirely in the visitor’s browser using JavaScript. No data is sent to a server or stored in the database.

Can I use more than one quiz on the same site?

Yes, just place the shortcode on any number of pages or posts.
